review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Engineer - Advanced
review_candidates.location: São Caetano do Sul, São Paulo, Brazil
review_candidates.description_excerpt: As an Infrastructure Engineer, you'll design, implement, and maintain robust systems that keep our PLM solutions running smoothly for customers worldwide. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and maintain Infrastructure as Code solutions using tools such as Terraform and Ansible. Build and maintain automation for provisioning, configuration management, operating system deployment, patching, monitoring, and system lifecycle management. Administer and support Windows and Linux server environments
eligibility_evidence: At Siemens Software, flexibility is how we work—hybrid by default, built on trust and autonomy.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: You'll work with cutting-edge technologies, collaborate with global teams, and have the opportunity to grow your expertise in a fast-paced, innovative environment. Qualifications Required 3+ years of experience in systems administration, infrastructure engineering, DevOps, or a related technical role. Strong hands-on experience administering Windows Server environments. We are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society, while ensuring that we attract the best talent based on qualifications, skills, and experiences.
